questions.questionText: What is commerce?

options.text: The study of trade and aids to trade

questions.explanation: The correct answer is The study of trade and aids to trade. Topic: trade.

questions.questionText: Which activity involves buying and selling goods?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Trade. Topic: home trade.

questions.questionText: What is home trade?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Trade within a country. Topic: foreign trade.

questions.questionText: Who buys in bulk from producers and sells to retailers?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Wholesaler. Topic: wholesaling.

questions.questionText: Who sells mainly to final consumers?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Retailer. Topic: retailing.

questions.questionText: Which aid to trade moves goods from one place to another?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Transport. Topic: transport.

questions.questionText: What is warehousing?

options.text: Storing goods until they are needed

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Storing goods until they are needed. Topic: warehousing.

questions.questionText: Which service transfers information between businesses?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Communication. Topic: communication.

questions.questionText: What is a main role of a commercial bank?

options.text: Accept deposits and provide financial services

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Accept deposits and provide financial services. Topic: banking.

questions.questionText: Which insurance principle requires disclosure of material facts?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Utmost good faith. Topic: insurance.

questions.questionText: Which business is owned by one person?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Sole trader. Topic: business ownership.

questions.questionText: Which source is generated from the owner's business?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Retained profit. Topic: finance.

questions.questionText: Which document requests payment from a buyer?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Invoice. Topic: documents.

questions.questionText: Which document acknowledges money received?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Receipt. Topic: payment.

questions.questionText: What is a cheque?

options.text: A written instruction to a bank to pay money

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A written instruction to a bank to pay money. Topic: marketing.

questions.questionText: What is advertising?

options.text: Paid communication used to promote goods or services

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Paid communication used to promote goods or services. Topic: consumer protection.

questions.questionText: What is a consumer?

options.text: A person who uses goods or services

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A person who uses goods or services. Topic: stock.

questions.questionText: Why is stock control important?

options.text: To maintain appropriate stock levels and reduce losses

questions.explanation: The correct answer is To maintain appropriate stock levels and reduce losses. Topic: pricing.

questions.questionText: What is entrepreneurship?

options.text: Identifying opportunities and organising resources to start or develop a business

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Identifying opportunities and organising resources to start or develop a business. Topic: entrepreneurship.

questions.questionText: What is profit?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Revenue minus costs. Topic: SMEs.

questions.questionText: Which type of warehouse stores imported dutiable goods until customs duty is paid?
questions.explanation: Bonded warehouses are supervised by ZIMRA until import duties are settled.

questions.questionText: In foreign trade, what does the Incoterm CIF (Cost, Insurance and Freight) mean?

options.text: Buyer pays shipping and marine insurance separately
Goods are delivered free to buyer's doorstep
Seller's quoted price covers goods cost, marine insurance, and freight to destination port

questions.explanation: CIF includes cost of goods, insurance, and sea freight to the named destination port.

questions.questionText: Which insurance principle prevents an insured person from making a profit out of a partial loss claim?
questions.explanation: Indemnity restores the insured to the exact financial position before loss—no profit.

questions.questionText: Which document is issued by a shipowner acknowledging receipt of goods loaded onto a vessel for export?
questions.explanation: A Bill of Lading serves as receipt, contract of carriage, and document of title to shipped goods.

questions.questionText: Which business organisation allows shareholders to enjoy limited liability while selling shares freely on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange (ZSE)?
questions.explanation: A Public Limited Company can list shares publicly on the stock exchange.

questions.questionText: What is a "crossed cheque" marked with two parallel lines across its face?

options.text: It can be cashed instantly over the bank counter
It has bounced due to insufficient funds
It is valid only outside Zimbabwe
It must be paid into a bank account and cannot be cashed over the counter

questions.explanation: Crossing prevents fraudulent cashing over the counter by requiring deposit into a bank account.

questions.questionText: Which consumer protection body in Zimbabwe handles complaints about unfair trade practices, misleading adverts, and defective products?

options.text: Standards Association of Zimbabwe (SAZ) / Consumer Council of Zimbabwe (CCZ)

questions.explanation: CCZ advocates for consumer rights and SAZ certifies product quality/safety standards.

questions.questionText: Which mode of transport is most economical for moving heavy coal from Hwange to Harare power stations?
questions.explanation: Rail transport handles bulk heavy minerals over long overland routes at low unit cost.

questions.questionText: In retail trade, what distinguishes a supermarket from a hypermarket?

options.text: Supermarkets have self-service; hypermarkets do not
Hypermarkets are much larger, located out of town with vast car parking and non-food sections

questions.explanation: Hypermarkets combine food, clothing, appliances, and huge parking on edge-of-town sites.

questions.questionText: What is an overdraft facility offered by a commercial bank?

options.text: Permission to withdraw more money than currently in a current account up to an agreed limit

questions.explanation: Bank overdrafts provide short-term flexible working capital on current accounts.

questions.questionText: Which advertising medium is most effective for demonstrating how a new kitchen appliance works to a national audience?
questions.explanation: Television combines sight, sound, colour, and live motion demonstration.

questions.questionText: Under hire purchase, when does legal ownership of a refrigerator pass to the buyer?

options.text: Only after the final instalment is paid
After half the instalments are paid

questions.explanation: In hire purchase, the customer hires goods until the final instalment transfers legal ownership.

questions.questionText: Which term describes an unfavourable Balance of Trade?

options.text: Visible imports exceed visible exports in value
A company sells at a loss

questions.explanation: Balance of Trade deficit occurs when visible imports > visible exports.

questions.questionText: Which mobile money & electronic clearing system enables instant bank-to-bank or wallet settlements in Zimbabwe?
questions.explanation: RTGS, ZIPIT, and mobile money platforms provide instant electronic funds transfer.

questions.questionText: What is the main advantage of containerisation in international cargo transport?

options.text: Speeds intermodal transfer, reduces pilferage/damage, and lowers packaging costs
Makes containers lighter than paper boxes
Only works for liquid crude oil

questions.explanation: Standardised sealed containers transfer smoothly between ship, rail, and truck with minimal damage/theft.
